Diego — legal is fine to proceed. I've countersigned Redwood's copy and attached our executed NDA (Redwood_NDA_signed_by_Redwood_20250619.pdf). A few notes for the share process:

- We require an executed NDA from the requesting party before we provide full Type II artifacts (signed PDF).
- For most buyers we provision a time-limited, access-logged link (SaaS Share) and require an internal point of contact for audit trail requests.
- If the external audit window they need extends beyond our Type II coverage, we may provide a bridge letter that explains control continuity and the audit period coverage; the bridge letter is a short, attested statement, not a replacement for the report.
- Redaction guidance: do not redact control testing results in a way that interferes with evidence of control operating effectiveness; redactions are limited to customer-identifiable data and internal-only operational details.

Suggested reply to the customer (feel free to edit):
"Hi Elena — attached is our countersigned NDA. Please countersign and return; once we have that we'll provision a time-limited, access-logged link to the SOC 2 Type II report. If you need a bridge letter, confirm the exact dates you'd like covered and we will prepare one. Our typical provisioning turnaround after an executed NDA is 24–48 business hours.
"
I've attached the signed NDA and a template bridge-letter we can adapt if needed. Add the HubSpot deal id (DL-78924) in the thread so we can tag the share in our records.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
